key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Trailing or twining herbaceous vine; stems sparsely hirsute to glabrous.

key_traits.label: Leaf morphology
key_traits.text: Blades about 4–7 cm long by 4–10 cm wide in FNA, palmately (5–)7(–9)-lobed nearly to the base; lobes lance-elliptic with irregularly sinuate, crenate, dentate, or pinnatifid margins.

key_traits.label: Inflorescence
key_traits.text: Flowers usually solitary, sometimes in small 2–3-flowered cymes.

key_traits.label: Sepals
key_traits.text: Oblong, about 18–25 mm, mucronate, enlarging/persisting around the fruit.

key_traits.label: Corolla
key_traits.text: White with a purplish/rose-purple throat, usually about 30–45 mm long.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Capsule about 1–2 cm, surrounded by an enlarged persistent calyx; seeds black and glabrous.

key_traits.label: Flowering
key_traits.text: April–November in Flora of North America.
